entries.label: Agricultural Drones
entries.quote: Relatively cheap drones with advanced sensors and imaging capabilities are giving farmers new ways to increase yields and reduce crop damage.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "Easy-to-use agricultural drones equipped with cameras, for less than $1,000."

entries.label: Ultraprivate Smartphones
entries.quote: New models built with security and privacy in mind reflect the Zeitgeist of the Snowden era.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "Mobile phones for the consumer market that transmit minimal personal information."

entries.label: Brain Mapping
entries.quote: A new map, a decade in the works, shows structures of the brain in far greater detail than ever before, providing neuroscientists with a guide to its immense complexity.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "A high-resolution map that shows structures of the human brain as small as 20 micrometers."

entries.label: Neuromorphic Chips
entries.quote: Microprocessors configured more like brains than traditional chips could soon make computers far more astute about what's going on around them.
entries.note: No sidebar on the web page. Organizations in article: Qualcomm, IBM Research, HRL Laboratories. Body text: Qualcomm chips "next year at the earliest".

entries.label: Genome Editing
key_players: Yunnan Key Laboratory of Primate Biomedical Research
entries.quote: The ability to create primates with intentional mutations could provide powerful new ways to study complex and genetically baffling brain disorders.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "The use of a genome-tool to create two monkeys with specific genetic mutations."

entries.label: Microscale 3-D Printing
entries.quote: Inks made from different types of materials, precisely applied, are greatly expanding the kinds of things that can be printed.

entries.label: Mobile Collaboration
entries.quote: The smartphone era is finally getting the productivity software it needs.

entries.label: Oculus Rift
entries.quote: Thirty years after virtual-reality goggles and immersive virtual worlds made their debut, the technology finally seems poised for widespread use.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "High-quality virtual-reality hardware that is cheap enough for the consumer market."

entries.label: Agile Robots
entries.quote: Computer scientists have created machines that have the balance and agility to walk and run across rough and uneven terrain, making them far more useful in navigating human environments.

entries.label: Smart Wind and Solar Power
entries.quote: Big data and artificial intelligence are producing ultra-accurate forecasts that will make it feasible to integrate much more renewable energy into the grid.

notes: Ten entries. Web date 2014-04-23. Each article has Breakthrough / Why It Matters / Key Players fields but no Availability field. Neuromorphic Chips has no sidebar on the web page. Quote is the article dek. Person names dropped from key players. Read through a summarising fetch per article; medium confidence.
